name: jmap-mcp
description: Read, organize, draft and send email on any JMAP server (Stalwart and others), with OAuth sign-in.
long_description: jmap-mcp connects Claude to your mailbox on a JMAP server such as Stalwart. Nothing to configure: ask Claude to connect your account, give your email address, and sign in on your mail server's own page in the browser. Your password never goes through Claude or this extension. Sending email is off by default and every message must be confirmed by you.

enable_send.title: Allow sending email
enable_send.description: Let Claude send email. Every message is still shown to you for confirmation before it leaves.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the connected mail accounts and the default one

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Connect a mail account from its email address (browser sign-in)

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List mailboxes with roles and unread counts

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search emails and return compact summaries

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Read one email as text with its attachments list

tools.name: update_emails
tools.description: Mark emails read, unread, flagged or unflagged

tools.name: delete_emails
tools.description: Move emails to the trash, or delete them after confirmation

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft or a reply
